entries.author: yishan
entries.summary: Xtags: a Chrome extension that labels each post in an X timeline with what it is trying to get from you — inducement, provocation, promotion, machine-generated, persuasion, entertainment, information — drawn as a tag plus a probability right after the timestamp.
